name: Hakanai Omoi ~Anemone~
source:
The city where the old and the new live together.
Hero lost parents early and last year his grandmother also died. Since then he moved to distant relatives. Occasionally a mysterious memory of a girl crosses his head and the level of confusion gradually rises...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一座新旧交融的城市。主人公早年失去了双亲，去年祖母也去世了。此后他搬到了远房亲戚家。偶尔，一个关于女孩的神秘记忆会掠过他的脑海，困惑感逐渐加深……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
